Prompts

```
['chunk a numpy array into overlapping segments of fixed size with configurable step', 'apply a causal or acausal sliding window to a numpy array using memory-efficient stride tricks', 'apply a function along an axis of a numpy array using multiprocessing for parallel execution', 'multiply an ND array by a 2D mixing matrix along specified axes for signal mixing', 'apply a 2D-only function to ND arrays by upcasting and iterating over batch dimensions']
```

```
{'chunk_array_into_segments': 'chunk a numpy array into overlapping segments of fixed size with configurable step', 'window_array_inplace': 'apply a causal or acausal sliding window to a numpy array using memory-efficient stride tricks', 'parallel_apply_along_axis': 'apply a function along an axis of a numpy array using multiprocessing for parallel execution', 'mix_array_with_matrix': 'multiply an ND array by a 2D mixing matrix along specified axes for signal mixing', 'upcast_apply_function': 'apply a 2D-only function to ND arrays by upcasting and iterating over batch dimensions'}
```
